project.name: sas-core :: sas-token
project.description: JOSE profile shared by the two SAS binaries: ES256 JWS for access and ID tokens (RFC 7515/7518), and the operator token the entitlement server (sas-ecs) issues and the CAMARA server (sas-camara) verifies — a JWS nested in an ECDH-ES A256GCM JWE (RFC 7516) so the subscriber number never travels readable through the device. Pure library: no I/O, no CDI, no REST. Crypto comes from Nimbus JOSE+JWT.
